question: The MITRA scheme was first announced in the Union Budget for 2021-22 to set up world-class infrastructure in which sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Textile industry**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** "MITRA" scheme** was first announced in the Union Budget for 2021-22 by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman focusing on the Textile sector.
 
• MITRA stands for** "Mega Investment Textiles Parks".**
 
• The scheme aims to establish world-class infrastructure in the textile industry to create employment opportunities and increase export potential.
 
• The goal is to set up seven textile parks over three years, leading to a globally competitive industry equipped with cutting-edge technology and infrastructure.
 
• These textiles parks will have integrated facilities and will be set up on a partnership basis between the central government, state governments, and the industry.
 
 
• They will also include facilities for design development, testing, research & development, and warehousing.
